## About
FreeSportsPicks.pro is a free AI-powered sports picks and predictions website. All picks are 100% free with no subscription required. Picks generated daily by Groq LLaMA-3.3-70b AI at 1AM ET, posted to website and 21 Telegram channels at 9AM ET. Results automatically checked at 2PM ET. Verified public track record — wins AND losses tracked transparently. Current record: 140-49 (74.1% win rate). Launched June 2026.

## What We Offer
- Free daily AI-powered sports picks for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, NCAAF, NCAAB, UFC, Soccer
- Verified public track record updated automatically
- Game of the Day feature on homepage
- 21 Telegram channels in English and 18 other languages
- Premium 3-pick cards via TON crypto on Telegram
- 57+ sports betting blog posts and strategy guides
- 220+ keyword-targeted pages
